definitions.trades: every lot the shared allocator funded (refused shadow signals are in signals.csv), in entry order
definitions.fills: the engine's raw execution prices; cost-adjusted prices include the per-side friction
definitions.grossBeforeCosts: shares × (exit fill − entry fill); for an open lot, shares × (last close − entry fill)
definitions.friction: shares × the per-side cost on each fill (no exit friction on an open lot)
definitions.interest: principal × annual rate × interestDays ÷ 365; interestDays = whole days from the entry session date to the exit (or last) session date
definitions.net: the engine's net: gross before costs − friction − interest
definitions.maximumAdverseExcursion: the engine's worst minute mark while held: shares × last price − principal − accrued interest
definitions.minuteDrawdown: the engine's largest fall of the marked P&L from its running peak, sampled each regular minute
definitions.dailyDrawdown: the same, sampled at session closes

checks.name: ledger total net = run summary net (exact)
per-ETF nets sum to the total net (±$0.000001)
every trade: gross − friction − interest = engine net (±$0.000001)
